subject.en: An amber-eyed ostrich in a brown hat with one bright feather cluster
subject.zh: 戴棕色宽檐帽的琥珀眼鸵鸟，帽上留一簇多彩羽毛

context: Schema-driven CLI generation and API credential management.
moment: The ostrich has just glanced back under its broad hat, a knowing, curious pause caught by a close portrait viewfinder.
interest: One attached coral, turquoise, blue, violet and golden feather cluster rises beside the hat and balances the bird’s glance.
paletteDirection: Warm tan, sandstone and cocoa across connected flat face, neck and hat facets; multicolor is concentrated in the one hat-feather cluster.
